items.title: Invest $25,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks to Start Building Retirement Income
items.summary: Four companies with decades of dividend raises span healthcare, staples, energy and real estate, and one pays nearly triple the yield of the others. Which one carries the biggest paycheck, and what risk does each hide for new retirees?

items.title: Realty Income and 2 More Monthly Dividend Stocks Built for Retirement Income
items.summary: A monthly payout means little if it vanishes in a downturn. Three monthly payers earned a spot by passing tests on coverage and balance sheets first, yet each one hides a different risk that retirees should watch before trusting the check.

items.title: $615,000 to Invest at 65: What an Annuity Pays vs. What a Dividend Portfolio Pays, Month by Month
items.summary: A fixed annuity promises a guaranteed paycheck but quietly loses ground to inflation every year, while a dividend portfolio starts lower yet can grow into something far larger. Before committing $615,000 either way, one comparison changes how both options look.

items.title: Invest $100,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks and Collect Passive Income for Life
items.summary: Selling shares in a down market to cover groceries is the retirement mistake planners fear most. Four blue-chip payers, including one that sends checks monthly, offer a way to keep the shares and still get paid.

items.title: Inflation Is Running Above 3%. These 3 Passive Income REITs Raise Rents to Keep Up.
items.summary: Consumer prices are climbing and Treasury yields are squeezing REIT valuations, yet some landlords hold a built-in raise clause. Three NYSE names take very different routes to outpace the cost of living, and one of them leaves retirees most exposed to rising rates.

items.title: Meet Wall Street’s Reliable High-Yield Dividend Stocks: 5 Companies That Pass the Yield Trap Test
items.summary: Treasuries now pay 5.12%, so a shaky dividend has nowhere to hide. We ran pipelines and landlords through a coverage test built for each business, and only a handful of payouts held up under the numbers.

items.title: How Retirees Can Turn $300,000 Into Passive Income With These 4 High-Yield Stocks
items.summary: Selling shares in a downturn locks in losses a retiree can never earn back. Four dividend payers from four different sectors offer another route, and each one carries a payout test and a risk worth checking before you buy.
